page.overview:
Who is Bud Clemons?

Bud Clemons (born 27 July 1918 and died 11 February 2001) was an American racing driver who participated regularly in midget car races in the late 1950s and early 1960s. He was unsuccessful in attempting to qualify for the Indianapolis 500 in 1957 and 1958.
